name: smallMultipleLines
title: Small Multiple Lines
description: One small line panel per group (e.g. study) comparing actual vs plan over time, with end labels showing value and % of plan and an on-track check

category.description: The x axis, usually a date or month.

group.description: One panel per value, for example Study.

values.description: The actual line (for example cumulative enrolled).

comparison.description: Optional. The plan or target line; end labels show the value as % of it.

subtitle.description: Optional. A text measure shown under each panel title.

tooltips.description: Extra measures shown in the tooltip.
